text:
Maya: Heads-up — I opened https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421 to convert the geo onboarding snippet to the new region header pattern. Noticed copies still mention specific zone IDs (e.g., eu-west-1) and an old residency sentence. Can folks eyeball?
Liam: On it. I saw the failing snippet tests in CI earlier — might be link rot + header rename. Will check Node/Python examples.
Andre: Quick note: the residency sentence needs to match legal copy. Suggested: 'For customers with EU Data Residency enabled, processed data is stored and processed within EU jurisdictions only.' Link to legal: https://redwood.ai/legal/data-residency
Sophie: CI is red for docs PRs that touch geo files. Run locally: `./scripts/check-snippets.sh docs/geo` — it flags missing example tags and broken permalinks.
Maya: Thanks — can we also standardize the header name to `X-Redwood-Region` in all examples? That avoids confusion with older `X-Region` usage.
Liam: I'll push a tiny commit updating examples. Proposed Node snippet: ```js
// node example
await client.generate({
  model: 'redwood/gpt-neox-20b',
  headers: { 'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu' }
});
```
Liam: And Python: ```py
# python example
resp = client.generate(model='redwood/gpt-neox-20b', headers={'X-Redwood-Region': 'eu'})
```
Andre: Also add a one-line footnote in the region matrix: 'EU Data Residency is available only for customers on Private or Dedicated plans; contact sales for enrollment.' That prevented a support ticket earlier.
Sophie: Adding link checks to the PR CI would help. I can add `scripts/check-links.sh` as a job that runs on docs changes. It already exists in infra repo so just reuse.
docs-bot: CI / docs/check-snippets — failed on docs/geo/onboarding.md: example-tag mismatch (line 42).
Maya: Cool — assigning Andre for wording, Liam for snippet updates, Sophie for CI job. Please ping here when you push. Small ask: include a changelog bullet under "Docs: geo onboarding header rename".
Liam: Pushed fix: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3421/files — updated examples + replaced region codes with placeholders (e.g., `eu`, `apac`). Ran `./scripts/check-snippets.sh` locally and it passes.
Andre: Wording change pushed to branch. Added legal link and the footnote in the region matrix table.
Sophie: Added the link-check job to the PR CI, included cache for the linter. Re-ran checks here and all green.
docs-bot: PR #3421 merged by Maya at 1718901899.
Maya: Great ship — thanks all. I'll follow up to make sure the SDK team picks up the header name in the official client docs too.
